name: eTrigue
description_en:
eTrigue currently presents a partner-marketing offering combining a platform, campaign content and execution services. The company page still identifies DemandCenter as its marketing-automation SaaS. That makes it important to distinguish buying access to a campaign builder from commissioning a managed partner program: the reviewed public pages describe both, without providing a universal self-service price.

DemandCenter campaigns arrange prospect actions around an audience, dates, waits, messages and internal alerts. Its practical value should be evaluated through a specific lead-delivery task and the permissions of the people receiving that lead. The following assessment uses official product and support pages; it does not verify program results, lead quality or actual delivery through an account test.
description_zh:
eTrigue 当前展示的是结合平台、营销内容与执行服务的伙伴营销方案。公司页仍将 DemandCenter 明确为营销自动化 SaaS。因此需要区分采购活动构建器访问权限，与委托伙伴营销项目：实读公开页面同时介绍两者，却未提供适用于所有客户的自助统一价格。

DemandCenter 活动围绕受众、日期、等待、消息与内部提醒组织潜客动作。评估实际价值时，应选择具体线索交付任务，并检查接收人员的权限。以下内容来自官方产品与支持页面，未通过账户测试验证项目效果、线索质量或真实投递。

core_features.explanation_en: Start defines audience, effective dates and a separate static test audience.
core_features.explanation_zh: Start 定义受众、有效日期，以及单独的静态测试受众。

core_features.explanation_en: Wait can reference a prospect DATE field and explicitly handle a missing value.
core_features.explanation_zh: Wait 可引用潜客 DATE 字段，并明确处理缺失值。

core_features.name_zh: 按优先级匹配提醒规则
core_features.explanation_en: The first matching campaign alert rule wins; an unmatched disabled default performs no alert.
core_features.explanation_zh: 活动提醒采用首个匹配规则；默认规则关闭且无匹配时不发提醒。

core_features.explanation_en: Validate checks required configuration while Test Action applies real behavior to test prospects.
core_features.explanation_zh: Validate 检查必要配置，Test Action 则对测试潜客执行真实行为。

en: Editorial fit: a partner-marketing team evaluating co-branded campaigns and accountable lead handoff.
Editorial fit: a B2B campaign operator who needs date-based nurture and rule-based internal alerts.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：评估联合品牌活动与可追踪线索交接的伙伴营销团队。
编辑判断的适用场景：需要按日期培育和按规则发送内部提醒的 B2B 活动运营人员。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Specify platform access, content and execution-service responsibilities in the evaluation scope.
steps.zh: 在评估范围中明确平台访问、内容及执行服务的责任。

steps.en: Define an audience and static internal test list in Start.
steps.zh: 在 Start 中定义受众及静态内部测试名单。

steps.en: Exercise a missing date, a blackout hold and an unmatched alert rule with approved internal data.
steps.zh: 用批准的内部数据测试缺失日期、禁发日扣留和无匹配提醒规则。

steps.en: Inspect results before choosing Pause, resume or an irreversible campaign End.
steps.zh: 检查结果后，再决定暂停、恢复或不可恢复的活动 End。

items.en: Current public material mixes platform and services; a specific commercial scope is necessary.
items.zh: 当前公开资料同时介绍平台与服务，需要明确具体商业范围。

items.en: Test Action performs real configured behavior on its test audience; it is not merely a preview.
items.zh: Test Action 对测试受众执行真实配置行为，不只是预览。

items.en: Campaign re-entry, pause-clock details, delivery retries and cross-partner data isolation were not tested.
items.zh: 未测试活动重入、暂停计时细节、投递重试或跨伙伴数据隔离。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Company page describes flat-fee, program-based pricing with unlimited company users, campaign frequency and customer activity. Services page says implementation, consulting and setup charges are absent and ongoing support is included, but exact program scope and contractual exceptions were not verified. No public amount or self-service checkout was established. Do not reuse the old directory starting price as a current quote or infer unrestricted database/channel usage.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 公司页介绍按项目收取固定费用，公司用户数、活动频率与客户活动不限。服务页说明无实施、咨询及设置收费，包含持续支持，但具体项目范围和合同例外未核实。未确认公开金额或自助结账方式。不能把旧目录起价当成当前报价，也不能推断数据库或渠道用量完全不受限。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Define whether the purchase is software or a program
sections.title_zh: 先界定采购平台还是项目
sections.en: The current company page combines Partner Marketing Automation and DemandCenter, while services describe co-branded content, landing pages, campaign execution and sales training. Treat these as separately scoped deliverables in an evaluation. A vendor-managed campaign does not establish that every asset or service is included in platform access. Ask for the specific program, operators, source content, lead handoff and reporting obligations rather than comparing an old directory monthly price with a full-service proposal.
sections.zh: 当前公司页同时介绍 Partner Marketing Automation 与 DemandCenter，服务页则介绍联合品牌内容、落地页、活动执行及销售培训。评估时应分别界定这些交付范围。厂商代运营活动，并不代表平台访问权限一定包含全部素材或服务。应明确项目、执行人员、源内容、线索交接及报告义务，避免把旧目录月价与完整服务提案直接比较。

sections.en: Start must be configured before a campaign can be saved or started. It supplies the audience lists, start/end timing and a static Test Audience. Campaign Type is a reporting label rather than a behavior switch. A hypothetical partner event follow-up should therefore define eligible prospects and dates explicitly; naming its type Webinar does not create registration or attendance logic. CRM campaign synchronization also applies only where the account is integrated and the relevant prospects are in CRM.
sections.zh: 保存或启动活动前必须配置 Start。它提供受众名单、开始／结束时间及静态 Test Audience。Campaign Type 是报告标签，而非行为开关。假设设计伙伴活动跟进，应明确合格潜客与日期；把类型命名为 Webinar 不会自动产生报名或出席逻辑。CRM 活动同步也仅适用于已集成账户及 CRM 中的相关潜客。

sections.title_en: Treat missing dates and blackout holds as decisions
sections.title_zh: 明确处理缺失日期与禁发日等待
sections.en: For a hypothetical renewal reminder, Wait can release prospects relative to a custom DATE field. The optional release-if-empty setting changes what happens when the renewal date is missing; indefinite waits instead need a qualifying activity to release someone. An enabled blackout check can add a hold after the normal waiting period ends. Define a missing-date response and a permissible release window before connecting an email. Do not assume that the specified delay alone is the actual send time.
sections.zh: 假设续费提醒使用自定义 DATE 字段，Wait 可按其相对日期放行。可选的缺失值立即放行设置，会改变续费日期缺失时的行为；无限期等待则需要合格活动才能放行。启用禁发日检查后，正常等待结束仍可能继续扣留。连接邮件前应明确缺失日期处理与允许放行窗口，不能把指定延迟直接当成实际发送时间。

sections.title_en: A routed alert still needs an eligible recipient
sections.title_zh: 路由提醒仍需要合格接收人
sections.en: Campaign Send Alert must have Properties configured, including recipient users or prospect owner and an alert message. Additional rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first match applies. If nothing matches and the default is disabled, the prospect continues without an alert. For real-time lead alerts, the separate troubleshooting guide also checks notification address, recipient selection and prospect ownership/visibility. Diagnose those layers before expanding permissions, especially when multiple partners must remain separated.
sections.zh: 活动中的 Send Alert 必须配置 Properties，包括接收用户或潜客负责人，以及提醒消息。附加规则自上而下评估，采用首个匹配。没有匹配且默认规则关闭时，潜客会继续前进而不发提醒。对于实时线索提醒，独立排障指南还要求检查通知地址、接收人选择及潜客归属／可见性。应先逐层定位，尤其在多个伙伴需要隔离时，不宜直接扩大权限。

sections.title_en: End cannot be used as a temporary pause
sections.title_zh: End 不能充当临时暂停
sections.en: The editing guide permits changes in Draft, Paused or Testing. Starting a paused campaign resumes existing members at the prior action if the end time has not passed; new members start from Start. Ending a campaign permanently prevents resuming or restarting that campaign, although it can be cloned. Decide whether a maintenance change needs Pause or End before using it. The page does not establish whether elapsed Wait time is frozen, so a resume test should include a prospect already waiting.
sections.zh: 编辑指南允许在 Draft、Paused 或 Testing 状态修改。若结束时间未到，启动暂停活动会让已有成员从此前动作继续，新成员从 Start 开始。End 会永久阻止该活动恢复或重启，虽然可以克隆。维护修改前应先决定使用 Pause 还是 End。该页没有说明已流逝的 Wait 时间是否冻结，因此恢复测试应包括已在等待的潜客。

sections.title_zh: Test Action 会产生实际影响
sections.en: Test Mode requires a Draft or Paused campaign without unsaved changes. Validate Campaign checks minimum action settings. Test Action immediately performs the selected action for the static Test Audience, applying its rules and record data. That is more consequential than checking syntax or viewing a preview. Use approved internal records with intentionally different field values and ownership, then inspect each result. No Test Action, recipient list change or live campaign operation was performed in this research.
sections.zh: Test Mode 要求活动为 Draft 或 Paused，且没有未保存修改。Validate Campaign 检查动作最低配置，Test Action 则立即对静态 Test Audience 执行选定动作，并应用规则与记录数据。因此它比语法检查或预览更具实际影响。应使用经批准的内部记录，有意设置不同字段值和归属，再逐项检查结果。本次研究未执行 Test Action、修改受众名单或操作真实活动。

sections.title_en: Read acceptance and engagement as different signals
sections.en: Campaign Effectiveness defines Delivered as receiving-mail-server acceptance. Opened depends on downloaded email images; it is not a direct observation of a person understanding the message. The default campaign summary combines its email templates. Keep that scope and denominator visible when comparing campaign changes. The company describes flat-fee, program-based pricing and unlimited company users, but the public pages reviewed do not settle contract amounts, database bounds, managed services or external channel costs. Those remain quote questions.
sections.zh: Campaign Effectiveness 将 Delivered 定义为收件邮件服务器接受。Opened 依赖邮件图片下载，并非直接观察到人员理解消息。默认活动摘要汇总其中的邮件模板。比较活动变化时，应明确这些范围与分母。公司介绍按项目收取固定费用及不限公司用户，但实读公开页面未解决合同金额、数据库边界、代运营服务或外部渠道成本。这些仍需具体报价。
